title: Canonical rationalization of a full embedded lattice
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite normed extension E of Q_ell with norm-integral ring A, a scheme X, a sheaf L of modules over the continuous E-valued coefficient sheaf, and a pro-etale object U. Let N be an embedded ell-lattice [def-sfb-embedded-ell-lattice] in L|U restricted to A: N is a submodule sheaf, is locally finite free, and locally every section of L|U has an ell-power multiple in N. Regard the explicitly constructed submodule sheaf N as an A-module M. There is an isomorphism alpha:E_X|U tensor_(A_X|U) M -> L|U [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] such that alpha(eta(1 tensor m)) is exactly the underlying ambient section of m, on every object of the slice.

proof.text: The inclusion j:N->L is A-linear and natural. The extension-restriction tensor adjunction gives the sectionwise map s tensor m |-> s j(m). Naturality follows on pure tensors and sheafification extends it uniquely to b:E tensor N->L. Its value on eta(1 tensor m) is j(m).

For an element z in the kernel of b, the local numerator assertion of [lem-sfb-lattice-scalar-extension-fractions] gives locally ell^n z=eta(1 tensor m). Applying b shows j(m)=0. Since N is a submodule, m=0. Multiplication by ell^n is injective on any E-module, so z is locally zero, hence zero by separatedness.

Fullness supplies locally a section m of N with j(m)=ell^n x. Then ell^(-n) eta(1 tensor m) maps to x. Thus b is locally surjective and injective, hence an isomorphism of sheaves and of module sheaves. Its already established unit formula supplies the normalization.
